text:
tasha: Heads-up: planning a short maintenance micro-window for az3 to nudge GPU pool balancing. 45m total, target 02:30-03:15 UTC next Wed. rolling cordon in 5m batches.

ben: Why 45m? seems tight for KV seed + smoke checks.

tasha: We only touch a small cohort (10 nodes) to reassign slab placement and refresh NIC microcode. Should be fast if canary passes.

omar: Expected delta on capacity? backward-compatible?

tasha: Expect ~4% total hosted capacity dip at peak for ~20m. We route streaming to fallback-llm-small for soft requests. No eviction for pinned tenants.

ravi: Any region constraints? az3 has higher batch traffic 02:00-03:00 UTC. Is that safe?

tasha: Good catch. We shift window forward 30m to avoid batch peak. Confirmed with telemetry.

priya: Cost impact? Any dedicated overtime?

tasha: Minimal. Fallback pools will absorb most load. We estimate +1.5% GPU minutes billed; set autoscale cap to +8% to be safe.

ben: Canary steps? concrete checks please.

tasha: Canary: cordon n-az3-canary-01 -> drain lowprio queues -> run kvseed job -> run 50 synthetic queries (latency + correctness) -> uncordon if green. Abort if errors >2 or p99 latency +150ms sustained 3m.

omar: Seed command?

tasha: 
```
kubectl cordon n-az3-canary-01
jobctl start kvseed --nodes n-az3-canary-01 --profile small
scripts/verify-canary.sh n-az3-canary-01
```

ravi: Who's on-call and incident owner?

priya: I can own spend + alerts. Ravi can be incident owner. Ben and Omar will surface runtime issues.

status-bot: Reminder scheduled: maintenance-notify-1769123456 -> status page + console banner (24h, 1h).

ben: Will open a quick dashboard: metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate, GPU-util, net-egress. Alert if error-rate >1.5% for 3m.

omar: Streaming behaviour? We should avoid hard-cutting streams.

tasha: Streams are sticky; we mark active streams as protected for the canary nodes. New streams go to fallback. That avoids mid-stream reconnects.

priya: Any fairness tweaks?

tasha: Temporarily increase fairness_shift tolerance to 0.2 and set eviction_sensitivity to low for the window. This prevents noisy preempts.

ben: Staging dry-run today?

tasha: Yes, 19:30 UTC staging dry-run. Omar will run and paste logs.

omar: I'll run and post results to this thread. If we see >1% errors in staging, we'll postpone.

ravi: Rollback plan?

tasha: Rollback: uncordon nodes, re-route traffic back, flush partial cache artifacts, and escalate to runtime (paging runtime-oncall). RTO target 25m.

priya: Budget alert: set on-call pager if spend goes +6% above baseline in 15m window. I'll configure now.

infra-bot: Maintenance announcement created: id=maint-1769123456, subscribers notified.

ben: Action items:
- ben: dashboard + alerts (EOD)
- omar: run staging dry-run (19:30 UTC)
- tasha: schedule canary steps and update runbook (before window)
- priya: autoscale cap & budget alerts (before window)
- ravi: be incident owner for the window

priya: all set on caps and alerting.

omar: Dry-run complete: no regressions, kvseed took 4m, synthetic checks p99 within 80ms baseline. Posting logs link: https://internal.corp/logs/1769123456/dryrun

ben: LGTM. :thumbsup:

tasha: Scheduling maintenance now. Will ping again 24h and 1h prior.

status-bot: Status page update posted: "Planned maintenance in az3: short micro-window, potential minimal capacity impact".

ravi: Thanks team.
